source: tests/acceptance/2d-x11.md#2d-x11.exa-operations: EXA Solid, Copy, Composite, Upload, Download

cases.criteria: PrepareSolid/Solid/DoneSolid on the 2D core for every GX alu and planemask the DDX accepts; x2d-fixture fill set exact
PrepareCopy/Copy/DoneCopy on the 2D core, overlap in every direction; x2d-fixture copy set exact
CheckComposite/PrepareComposite/Composite on the route ADR 0003 chooses; rendercheck composite groups 0 fail
UploadToScreen exact for every depth the DDX accepts
DownloadFromScreen exact for every depth the DDX accepts
PrepareAccess/FinishAccess wait for the BO fence and leave no CPU write unflushed (x2d-fixture pixmap set)
